node: Data-center power, thermal, and balance-of-plant infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around AI data-center power, cooling, and balance-of-plant constraints. The reference lane is Vertiv, which defines the obvious liquid-cooling and power-infrastructure benchmark but is already high-attention and mega-cap. The underfollowed discovery lane favors less obvious public suppliers that screen as legacy electrical equipment, HVAC, components, or industrial power vendors: Bel Fuse for rack/server power conversion and connectivity, AAON for customized data-center air-side and liquid cooling, and Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and electrical distribution. These are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations.
